title: A beautiful, enriching experience

author: mthelu

title: When Seville was told to me…
text:
Very interesting and informative tour 
Caroline shared with us a bit of her immense knowledge of Seville and its history to better understand this very beautiful city and Andalusia in every neighborhood or building: the Moorish invasion, the golden age of the colonies and its merchant port via the Guadalquivir "gateway to the Indies," 1492, a year very rich in events, then the decolonization and the Ibero-American Exposition of 1929, the expulsion of the Jews, the tobacco factory and the "revolt" of the women (Carmen), the nationalism and traditionalism of the Franco period and its patriarchy…
author: Cathy54630

title: Great discovery of Seville with the kids
text:
We took a discovery tour of Seville with our 2 young children aged 11 and 5. They were fascinated and so were we.
We highly recommend Caroline who introduced fun elements into the tour.
author: Excursion31187511589

title: Very beautiful private tour experience.
text: Caroline had us walk through the alleys of Seville while telling us its history. She knows how to capture and adapt to her audience. We had a pleasant time. Because of her approachability, we felt like we were taking the tour with a friend. Only regret is not having planned a 2nd visit.
author: 810st_phanev

title: TOUR OF THE HISTORIC DISTRICTS OF SEVILLE
text:
I visited the historic districts of Seville with my children.
We had an excellent time. The tour accompanied by Caroline from Vivir al Andalu was very pleasant and enriching. 
A big thank you to our guide, who was very pleasant and fascinating. We really appreciated her way of helping us discover this city.
A beautiful experience that I recommend.

title: Beautiful discovery of Seville
text:
4-hour stroll with Caroline, for the discovery of Seville, its culture, its rich heritage and its inhabitants.
Caroline has a perfect knowledge of her city, its history, and the habits and customs of its inhabitants.
We highly recommend.
Thank you Caroline.
Isabelle and Philippe.
author: 977zazab

title: Essential tour of Seville in French
text: Caroline was able to take us on a 2.5-hour bike ride and bring the history of Seville to life for us: it was very educational, passionate, and fascinating. Rarely have I had a tour that I enjoyed so much. We even regretted not having taken the 4-hour tour.
author: nutria31

title: A visit not to be missed
text: Superb time spent with Caroline, who brings her Andalusia to life for us. The anecdotes throughout the tour help to better understand this city. The icing on the cake, the tasting of quality tapas with all the explanations is a real plus!
